mapper.select: select count(1) as cnt from ${msg_data} where cur_state = '0' and ifnull(req_date,sysdate()) <= sysdate() and sent_date is null and msg_type = ${msg_type} limit 1
mapper.update: update ${msg_data} set cur_state = '1' ,sent_date = str_to_date('${group_no}','%Y%m%d%H%i%S') where cur_state = '0' and ifnull(req_date,sysdate()) <= sysdate() and sent_date is null and msg_type = '${msg_type}' limit 1000
mapper.select: select count(1) as cnt from ${msg_data} where cur_state = '0' and ifnull(req_date,sysdate()) <= sysdate() and sent_date is null and msg_type = ${msg_type} and cont_seq is not null limit 1
mapper.update: update ${msg_data} set cur_state = '1' ,sent_date = str_to_date('${group_no}','%Y%m%d%H%i%S') where cur_state = '0' and ifnull(req_date,sysdate()) <= sysdate() and sent_date is null and msg_type = '${msg_type}' and cont_seq is not null limit 1000
update ${msg_data} set cur_state = '2' where cur_state = '1' and sent_date = str_to_date('${group_no}','%Y%m%d%H%i%S') and msg_type = '${msg_type}'
update ${msg_data} set cur_state = '0', sent_date = null where cur_state = '1' and sent_date = str_to_date('${group_no}','%Y%m%d%H%i%S') and msg_type = '${msg_type}'
mapper.select: select msg_seq ,sms_txt as msg_txt ,sms_txt as sms_txt ,call_to ,userdata ,'S' as msgtype ,'' as msg_txt_title ,call_from ,'ph' as messagetype ,'D' as pcom ,'N' as crypto ,date_format(sysdate(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S') as curr_date from ${msg_data} st where cur_state = '1' and msg_type = ${msg_type} and sent_date = str_to_date('${group_no}','%Y%m%d%H%i%S')

select msg_seq ,mci.mms_body as msg_txt ,mci.mms_body as sms_txt ,call_to ,userdata ,'L' as msgtype ,mci.mms_subject as msg_txt_title ,call_from ,'ph' as messagetype ,'D' as pcom ,'N' as crypto ,date_format(sysdate(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S') as curr_date from ${msg_data} md ,${mms_contents_info} mci where cur_state = '1' and msg_type = '${msg_type}' and md.cont_seq = mci.cont_seq and sent_date = str_to_date('${group_no}','%Y%m%d%H%i%S')
mapper.insert: insert into ${msg_log} select * from ${msg_data} where msg_seq = '${msg_seq}'

update ${msg_log} set cur_state = '3' ,rslt_date = str_to_date('${rslt_date}','%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S') ,rslt_code = '${rslt_code}' ,rslt_code2 = '${rslt_code2}' ,rslt_net = '${rslt_net}' where msg_seq = '${msg_seq}'
mapper.update: create table if not exists ${msg_log} like ${msg_data}
